headword: {糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん}

definitions.explanation: A dietary approach that limits the intake of sugars and carbohydrates. Widely popular in Japan as a weight-loss and health management method.

examples.japanese: {糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん}を{始|はじ}めた。
{糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん}ダイエットで{三|さん}キロ{痩|や}せた。
examples.english: I lost three kilograms on a low-carb diet.

examples.japanese: {医師|いし}から{糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん}を{勧|すす}められたが、{白|しろ}いご{飯|はん}をやめるのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: The doctor recommended carbohydrate restriction, but it's hard to give up white rice.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common health and diet term in modern Japan. Often shortened to {糖質|とうしつ}オフ or {低糖質|ていとうしつ} on food packaging. Distinct from {炭水化物|たんすいかぶつ}{制限|せいげん}, which is more technical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん}ダイエット (low-carb diet)
- {糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん}{食|しょく} (carb-restricted meals)
- ゆるい{糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん} (loose/moderate carb restriction)
- {厳|きび}しい{糖質|とうしつ}{制限|せいげん} (strict carb restriction)
